# MtaaLink

> An all-in-one management platform for Kenyan organizations — members, contributions, meetings, projects, elections with SMS voting, and SMS announcements.

## About
- Built in Kenya, 2025
- Founder: Elijah Sukano
- Free during early access

## Key Features
- Members & groups management
- Contributions tracking (M-PESA and cash)
- Meetings with agendas, attendance, and auto-generated minutes
- Projects with milestones and budgets
- Elections with SMS voter codes and live results
- Announcements delivered via SMS to all members
- PDF reports for everything

## Key Facts
- Runs in any browser, no app download needed
- Works on any phone — Android, iPhone, or desktop
- SMS voting works on feature phones
- One price: KES 2,500/month (free during early access)
